name: Giant Rat
description: A dog-sized sewer scavenger that swarms anything that looks like dinner.
tactics: Comes in packs. Use 1 rat per player for an easy fight.

name: Giant Spider
description: A wall-crawling ambusher that wraps its prey in silk and bites from above.

powers.name: Venom Bite
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

tactics: Drops from the ceiling. Saves its venom for a player in light armor.

name: Blink Cat
description: A six-legged black cat that always seems to be standing a step to the left of where it actually is.
skillNote: Attacks against it have disadvantage until it is hit once.

powers.name: Phase Shift
powers.text: No damage. Once per rest it turns the first hit against it into a miss.

tactics: Circles the party and attacks whoever is alone. Flees if its illusion is broken twice.

name: Cave Sucker
description: A leathery, bat-winged leech that eats power cables and ship hulls.
tactics: Clings to ships and gnaws wiring. Gets disturbed by loud noise.

name: Frost Strider
description: A shaggy, two-legged snow lizard ridden across the ice fields.
tactics: Sturdy mount in the cold. Drops dead if left out in the open overnight.

name: Snow Mauler
description: A white-furred ice-field hunter that hauls prey back to a cave for later.
tactics: Grabs one target and drags it off. Players that cut it free have advantage to escape.

name: Cosmic Whale
description: A starlit, ship-sized whale that sings across the void and hauls tiny cargo ships along in its slipstream.
tactics: Peaceful. Fights only if its calves are threatened; otherwise it hums.

name: Rat King
description: A knot of fused rats with one hundred eyes and one terrible, whispery voice.

powers.name: Plague Swarm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Anyone damaged is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

tactics: Lurks below cities. Sends rats at the party in waves while it stays in the sewers.

name: Hive Stalker
description: A sleek black insectoid hunter with a second set of jaws, acid for blood and an unblinking, eyeless face.

powers.name: Acid Blood
powers.text: No damage. Whoever hits it in melee for 5 or more takes d6 damage and loses an item.

tactics: Stalks from vents and ceilings. Drags one victim away at a time to the nest.

name: Swarmling
description: A claw-limbed, carapaced hunter that comes in the thousands from the dark between stars.
tactics: Moves as a mob. Leaders on the hive mind tell them where to bite.

name: Chitin Crusher
description: A house-sized, armored bio-engineered monster with bone cannons and a mouth for every limb.
tactics: Smashes through walls. Takes a long time to drop.

name: Dust Rattler
description: A cart-sized rattlesnake that makes a sound like gravel in a tin can.

powers.name: Venom
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

tactics: Strikes from under rocks and wagon wheels. Retreats after a bite.

name: Horned Jackrabbit
description: A rabbit with antlers that mimics human voices and starts bar fights for sport.
tactics: Mimics a player's voice to lure others away. Cannot be caught by a man with a good singing voice.

name: Thunder Herd
description: A thousand-ton wave of bison with a dust cloud that can be seen for miles.

powers.name: Stampede
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Flattens everything in its path.

tactics: Cannot be turned except by a loud noise, a big fire or a very clever player.

name: Neon Gutter Cat
description: A scruffy alley cat with glowing cyber-eyes, a robotic tail and a talent for knocking over trash cans.
tactics: Hisses, scratches and vanishes into the neon. Purrs at anyone with food.

name: Sewer Gator
description: A pale, blind, six-meter alligator that grew fat on dumped lab waste and the occasional squatter.
tactics: Lurks under manholes and in drainage tunnels. Drags prey into the water.

name: Chomp Ball
description: A red, toothy, bouncing ball of meat that eats anything and farts a lot.
tactics: Bounces at the nearest target. Can be ridden, with disadvantage.

name: Dream Cat
description: A sleek, star-eyed cat that walks through dreams and keeps an eye on anyone who tries to hurt cats.
tactics: Warns against danger in dreams. Fights only to protect other cats.

name: Void Hound
description: A rail-thin, blue-black hound that steps out of the corners of rooms and walls and never stops hunting.

powers.name: Angle Step
powers.text: No damage. Appears from any corner within sight and attacks with advantage.

tactics: Tracks a victim across time and space. Cannot be outrun, only outsmarted.

name: Moss Tortoise
description: A hill-sized, mossy tortoise with a village on its back and a very, very slow temper.
tactics: Takes a turn to turn around. Withdraws into its shell if hit hard.

name: Carrion Crow
description: A scraggly black crow with a cold, intelligent eye that watches the battlefield and always seems to know who's next.
tactics: Circles overhead. Pecks at the wounded and fallen.

name: Abyssal Leviathan
description: A hundred-meter, barnacle-crusted sea serpent that rises from the dark and swallows ships whole.

powers.name: Tidal Surge
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A wave that knocks everyone prone.

tactics: Attacks ships and coastal docks. Dives and re-surfaces from below.

name: Mountain Mammoth
description: A shaggy, house-high mammoth with tusks like fallen trees and a stampede that shakes the glacier.
tactics: Charges in a line. Cannot turn quickly.

name: Parrot Lookout
description: A colorful, foul-mouthed parrot who repeats secrets and spots every enemy ship before the captain does.
tactics: Squawks the alarm. Repeats private conversations at the worst time.

name: Pirate Crab
description: A big hermit crab wearing a tricorn hat, a pirate-flag shell and a deep resentment of seagulls.
tactics: Defends its treasure pile, which is mostly bottle caps. Scuttles away sideways if hurt.

name: Reef Shark
description: A six-foot, grey-finned shark that smells blood from a mile away and has no manners.
tactics: Circles first. Attacks swimmers and bleeding targets.

name: Glow Rat
description: A cat-sized rat that glows green in the dark and does not care about your lunch.
tactics: Swarms. Attacks wounded players first.

name: Atomic Roach
description: A dog-sized cockroach that survived the end of the world and is mildly annoyed by it.
tactics: Skitters in packs. Flees from light and a hard stomp.

name: Rad Hound
description: A mangy, two-headed wild dog with a green-glowing eye and a limp.
tactics: Runs in packs of 3. Can be tamed with food (Charm challenge).

name: Soot Pigeon
description: A grubby, sooty pigeon with a tiny brass message tube strapped to one leg and a very big attitude.
tactics: Steals crumbs and delivers the occasional message. Flocks in large numbers.

name: Iron Draft Horse
description: A massive, calm draft horse with iron-shod hooves and a brass-plated leg brace, hauling a steam carriage.
tactics: Stands its ground. Bolts if frightened by a loud bang or steam whistle.

name: Smog Hound
description: A black, sooty, ember-eyed hound that prowls the fogged streets of a coal town.
tactics: Hunts at night, in fog. Loses the track in clean air.

name: Chrome Rat King
description: A knot of cybernetic rats wired into one scheming sewer lord.

powers.name: Rat Flood
powers.text: Area 2d6 damage to all enemies, ignores defense.

tactics: Sends rats in first to cut wires and steal gear, then bursts out of the drain when the group is split up.

name: Library Silverfish
description: A silver bug the size of a cat that nibbles forbidden books and burps whispers.
tactics: Scurries between shelves and hides in the dark. Hisses a few words of old tongue if squished.

name: Thunder Ram
description: A broad mountain ram whose horns crack like lightning.

powers.name: Thunder Charge
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is knocked back and has disadvantage until it stands.

tactics: Charges from the high ground and rams into anything that glints.

name: Sludge Pup
description: A cheerful ooze shaped vaguely like a puppy that loves to be petted.
tactics: Wobbles up to anyone with food. Splits in two if it sneezes.

name: Crow Informant
description: A smart crow in a tiny hat that trades gossip for shiny buttons.
tactics: Perches on lamps and listens in. Sells what it hears to anyone with a shiny coin.

name: Nebula Stalker
description: A void-bred predator the size of a freighter that hunts engine wakes through open space.

powers.name: Engine Swallow
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target's ship or vehicle is crippled until repaired.

tactics: Rushes the loudest engine first. Retreats to a nebula if badly hurt.

name: Dust Raptor
description: A feathered desert predator that hunts in packs across the canyons of a dusty outer-rim moon.
tactics: Circles the group, then dives at the one who falls behind.

name: Hive Hound
description: A lean, chitin-plated hunter bred by a hive-fleet to track prey through ship corridors.
tactics: Hunts by smell. Goes for the wounded first.

name: Bulkhead Ravager
description: A hulking six-limbed horror that tears through armored doors to reach its prey.

powers.name: Door Breaker
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pinned until it breaks free.

tactics: Rips down a door and charges the biggest player. Ignores minor wounds.

name: Cyber Hound
description: A guard dog with a steel jaw and an eye that glows red when it sees an intruder.
tactics: Chases whoever smells wrong. Leashed to a security console.

name: Chrome Panther Prime
description: A custom-built luxury predator with a stealth coat and a vat-grown killer instinct.

powers.name: Ambush Pounce
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is knocked prone.

tactics: Cloaked until the first strike. Picks off a lone player, then retreats.

name: Great White Buffalo
description: A huge albino bison that walks through the plains as if the land itself had stood up.

powers.name: Stampede
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is trampled and knocked prone.

tactics: Charges through the camp. Stops if someone shows it respect.

name: Graveyard Hound
description: A lean black dog that haunts cemetery fences and watches the living with pale eyes.
tactics: Stalks the group at a distance. Bites the one walking behind.

name: Hellhound Stalker
description: A smoke-black hound with burning eyes that has been sent after one specific victim.

powers.name: Hellfire Breath
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is set on fire.

tactics: Ignores everyone except its mark. Backs off if it is doused with holy water.

name: Hammerhead Terror
description: A hammerhead shark with the shoulders of a bull, famous for ramming small boats.
tactics: Rams a dinghy first, then circles the survivors.

name: Kraken Spawn
description: A ship-sized squid, the child of a legendary monster, that drags small vessels below.
tactics: Grabs the rail and pulls. Retreats if its limbs are cut.

name: Boiler Rhino
description: A rhino fitted with a coal-burning steam engine on its back and iron plates on its hide.
tactics: Builds up steam, then charges in a straight line. Stuck if its horn hits a wall.

name: Steam Drake
description: A brass-plated dragon-engine that vents scalding steam and lives in the cellar of a clockwork castle.

powers.name: Scalding Cloud
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Burns terrain, and the steam blocks sight.

tactics: Fills the room with steam, then dives at the one who cannot see.

name: Rad-Bear
description: A mutated grizzly the size of a truck with a glowing hide and no fear of anything.
tactics: Charges the nearest player. Ignores minor wounds.

name: Doom Hound Alpha
description: The scarred leader of a mutant dog pack, with a metal plate in its skull and a thousand scars.

powers.name: Howl of the Pack
powers.text: Calls 2 Rad Hounds to the fight.

tactics: Calls its pack with a howl. Goes for the throat of whoever hurt it.

name: Prism Moth
description: A palm-sized moth with wings of stained starlight that scatters the glow of nearby lamps.

powers.name: Prismatic Dazzle
powers.text: A flash of color. One target has disadvantage until their next turn.

tactics: Flutters around a lamp. Dazzles the first player who swats at it.

name: Jackalope Gang
description: A small herd of antlered rabbits that steal hats and laugh like cowboys.

powers.name: Hat Snatch
powers.text: Steals one item from a target and runs. They get it back if the jackalope is caught.

tactics: Steals a hat and runs. Impossible to catch by foot.

name: Bouncing Grub-Pup
description: A round little bug-dog that bounces in circles and bites ankles with tiny teeth.
tactics: Bounces off the walls. Distracted by shiny things.

name: Overdramatic Raven
description: A black raven that perches on every windowsill and quotes poetry at the worst times.
tactics: Recites a doomy rhyme. Flies away if ignored.

name: Drowned Pack
description: A pack of drowned hounds that follows a ship through the fog and howls up through the hull.
tactics: Climbs over the rail in the dark. Retreats at dawn.

name: Wasteland Vulture
description: A six-foot vulture with a scorched beak that circles anything that stops moving.
tactics: Circles overhead. Swoops on the wounded.

name: Prairie Hawk
description: A large, sharp-eyed hawk that follows wagon trains and swoops on spilled jerky.
tactics: Circles the camp. Steals meat from plates.

name: Albatross Omen
description: A huge white albatross that follows a ship for days and gets very angry if harmed.
tactics: Glides behind the ship. Curses a sailor if it is hurt.

name: Barn Cat Terror
description: A fat farmhouse tabby that has killed every mouse in three villages and is now looking at the players.
tactics: Bats at dangling items. Lands on a player's head.

name: Plasma Panther
description: A jet-black panther with veins of blue plasma that stalks space stations through the maintenance ducts.

powers.name: Plasma Pounce
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is burned and knocked prone.

tactics: Cloaked in the dark until the first strike. Tears out lights before attacking.

name: Scout Lizard
description: A six-legged survey lizard that hisses at everything on the plain.
tactics: Skitters and hisses. Calls its herd with a screech.

name: Astral Stag
description: A towering stag with antlers of woven constellations that walks the ley-lines of the stars.

powers.name: Constellation Gore
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Antlers pin the target until they break free.

tactics: Walks slowly through the group and tests them with a glare. Charges anyone with malice.

name: Void Krill Swarm
description: A cloud of tiny, translucent crustaceans that eat through space-suit seals and hull plates alike.

powers.name: Hull Eater
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Corrodes gear and armor in the zone.

tactics: Surrounds the group. Targets any gap in a suit.

name: Grot Hound Pack
description: A fast, gangly pack of xenos hounds that fly on rotor-scales and howl through the ceiling vents.
tactics: Strikes in packs of three. Drops from above and retreats into the vents.

name: Chaos Hydra
description: A many-headed horror that vomits fire and spits warp-spawn from every neck.

powers.name: Triple Bite
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Three heads bite at once, ignoring defense.

tactics: Grows a new head when one is cut. Burns whatever it cannot bite.

name: Back-Alley Tiger
description: A sleek, augmented tiger kept by a night-club owner and loosed on anyone who skips the bill.
tactics: Bounds across rooftops. Jumps at the player with the most expensive gear.

name: Prairie Skyray
description: A flat, kite-shaped ray of air that glides above the plains and stings with a whip-like tail.
tactics: Glides silently above the herd. Dives on a lone rider.

name: Barghest Warden
description: A huge black hound with eyes like dying coals that guards the churchyards of old cities.
tactics: Stays by the gate. Chases anyone who tries to leave a grave open.

name: Great White Terror
description: A thirty-foot shark with a harpoon still stuck in its jaw and a grudge against every captain.

powers.name: Savage Rush
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is dragged underwater.

tactics: Circles the ship and rams the hull. Goes for a sailor who falls overboard.

name: Boiler Wyrm
description: A smoke-belching eel of iron plates that lives in the boiler rooms of old steamships.

powers.name: Steam Burst
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Scalds everyone in the zone.

tactics: Rises out of the steam. Retreats into the pipes when hurt.

name: Irradiated Aurochs
description: A wasteland bull the size of a bus, with a radioactive glow and a horn like a crowbar.

powers.name: Horn Impale
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pinned until they break free.

tactics: Charges the first thing that moves. Slow to turn.

name: Hive Wyvern
description: A bat-winged hunter bred by a hive-fleet to dive on ground troops and rip armor open.

powers.name: Armor Rend
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Armor does not count and is damaged.

tactics: Dives from above. Targets whoever wears the heaviest armor.

name: Neon Pigeon Flock
description: A flock of cybernetic pigeons with LED-lit wings that carry ads and steal data chips from passersby.
tactics: Swarms the group and pecks at anything shiny. Scatters if one is hit.

name: Thunder Goose
description: A honking, storm-fat goose who believes every pond, field and kingdom is hers.

powers.name: Lightning Honk
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Targets are deafened until they rest.

tactics: Charges the loudest player first. Calms down if someone offers bread.

name: Carnival Star-Whale
description: A gigantic, gentle space whale hung with lanterns and carrying a whole traveling fair on its back.

powers.name: Song of the Deep
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hit targets cannot attack the whale until they rest.

powers.name: Breaching Splash
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Targets are knocked prone.

tactics: Only fights to protect the fair on its back. Calm it down and it turns into an ally.

name: Great Bison Stampede
description: A thundering herd of buffalo that turns the whole prairie into a battering ram.

powers.name: Stampede
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Targets are knocked prone.

powers.name: Dust Cloud
powers.text: No damage. Players cannot see more than a pencil away until it clears.

tactics: Runs in straight lines. Fire or a good canyon turns it.

name: Mutant Mammoth
description: A giant two-headed, furred elephant that hauls supply caravans, or tramples them.

powers.name: Trample
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Targets are knocked prone.

powers.name: Tusk Toss
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage. Throws the target a pencil length away.

tactics: Protective of its herd. Can be tamed by keeping its calf safe.

name: Thunder Herdbeast
description: A huge shaggy, horned desert mount that can carry a whole tribe and is gentler than it looks.
tactics: Gentle until frightened. A stampede ends when its rider calms it down.
